[[File:Cairn Isle icon detail.png|left|130px]]
'''Cairn Isle''' is an island on the south-west of [[Karamja]], south of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] and west of [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]]. To access the island, players must scale a small promontory stood on the Karamjan coastline by climbing up a [[Rock slide (Cairn Isle)|rockslide]] (requires 15 [[Agility]]), and then walk across the wooden bridge linking up the two islands. In case the player stumbles while climbing the rockslide, they will slide back down and take damage. If the player fails to keep their balance while crossing the bridge, they will fall off and be washed back to the shoreline of Karamja, again taking damage.

The isle is involved in both [[Tai Bwo Wannai Trio]] and [[Shilo Village]] quests. One of [[Timfraku]]'s sons, [[Tinsay]], resides in Cairn Isle before the player convinces him back to the village in [[Tai Bwo Wannai Trio]] quest. [[Rashiliyia]]'s son [[Bervirius]] is also buried on the isle in the [[Tomb of Bervirius]], accessible by climbing down the [[well stacked rocks]] on the isle.

Exploring Cairn Isle is an easy task in the Karamja [[Achievement Diary]].

===Success chance===
The chance of successfully crossing the bridge to Cairn Isle is dependent on the player's Agility level, scaling up to a 98% chance at a safe passage at level 99.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1056877354641997824|date=29 October 2018|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/104902|archivedate=9 December 2022|quote=[I always wondered how the bridge to Cairn Island worked. Is fail rate based on agility level? What is the rate of failing?] Yes, the fail rate is based on your Agility level, decreasing to about 2% at level 99.}} 

Whether the player walks or runs across the bridges does not influence this skill check. Successfully crossing the bridge displays the message {{mes|You manage to keep your balance on the bridge.}}

{{Skilling success chart|xlabel=Agility level|ylabel=Success chance
|label1=Crossing the bridge|low1=75|high1=250|image1=Agility icon.png}}

Damage taken from failing to traverse the bridge is split across three equal hitsplats based on the player's current hitpoints, with the damage formula for each hitsplat being <math display="inline">\left\lfloor \text{Hitpoints} \times \frac{1}{11}\right\rfloor</math>.

==Sailing info==
Players can [[mooring point|dock]] just south of Cairn Isle with level 42 [[Sailing]]. The dock offers the following utilities for sailors:
*[[File:Salvaging station map icon.png|link=Salvaging station]] [[Salvaging station]]
*[[File:Ledger table icon.png|link=Ledger table]] [[Ledger table]]

Although there is no [[notice board]] to get [[courier tasks]] from here, a few courier tasks involve delivering cargo to or picking up cargo from Cairn Isle.
